Why Obby?

Obsidian is powerful and extensible. Obby intentionally stays smaller: native macOS, plain Markdown, and AI built directly around your files.

At a glanceObbyObsidianCloud AI note apps
Plain Markdown filesObby✓Obsidian✓Cloud AI note appsVaries
Native macOSObby✓ObsidianNo · ElectronCloud AI note appsVaries
Local AIObby✓ · OllamaObsidianVia pluginsCloud AI note appsVaries
AI can work with files/foldersObby✓ObsidianVia pluginsCloud AI note appsVaries
No note database requiredObby✓Obsidian✓Cloud AI note appsVaries
Cloud AI provider supportObby✓ObsidianVia pluginsCloud AI note appsVaries
PDF/document readingObby✓ObsidianPDFs built in; more via pluginsCloud AI note appsVaries
Plugin ecosystemObbyNoObsidian✓Cloud AI note appsVaries
Simple by defaultObby✓ · Intentionally minimalObsidianConfigurableCloud AI note appsVaries

Cloud AI note apps are a broad category; features vary by app and plan. Obsidian’s AI capabilities depend on the plugins and models you choose. “Native macOS” refers to a native interface, not simply availability on Mac.

Obsidian references: File storage · Plugins · Desktop framework

That’s basically it.

Obby is meant to stay small.
